integrity: Two standalone independent exhaustive C++17 enumerators use distinct graph constructions and independent propagation/combination procedures. Their exact eight-cell histograms agree. Numerical results depend on correct execution of the bundled programs.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computation on the unique 50-vertex (50,7,0,1) strongly regular graph, with standard power domination and synchronous observation rounds. No infinite-graph theorem, no full structural characterization of the successful six-sets, and no external independent mathematical audit. The Smith–Hicks full text was unavailable to this literature comparison.
title: Minimum power domination and exact propagation-time census of the Hoffman–Singleton graph
